description_en: Beige long-sleeve wrap top with a deep V, side tie and flared cuffs, a pink pleated mini skirt, pink bow choker and bow shoulder bag, white ribbed slouch socks and beige bow ballet flats.
notes: Footwear is flats over socks; vocab has no flats, so 'socks' chosen. Legs between skirt and socks are bare mannequin.

description_en: Pale blue sheer puff-sleeve bolero with bows over a white lace-trimmed bustier top, a pink pleated mini skirt with tulle underlayer, pearl necklace, quilted cream bag, white thigh-high stockings and white strappy bow sandals.
notes: Tag says socks but they are opaque thigh-high stockings. Heels are strappy sandals with moderate heel; footwear 'heels' chosen over 'sandals'.

description_en: Yellow button-front shirt dress with a big waist bow and tiered flared hem under a cropped denim jacket with rolled sleeves, straw basket bag, sheer white knee-high socks with wide bands and white platform sneakers.
notes: Grey areas of leg above the socks are mannequin. Socks look sheer, possibly lace-textured.

description_en: Black lingerie set with gold star embroidery: strappy underwire bra, lace garter belt with suspender straps, lace thong, sheer black thigh-high stockings with wide lace tops, and black patent ankle-strap stilettos.
notes: Stockings are held by garter clips; footwear 'heels' chosen over 'stockings'.

description_en: Lavender lace lingerie set: ruffled lace-up corset top with front bow and peplum, sheer lace shorts-style panties with side bows, matching ribbon choker and sheer lace-top thigh-high stockings with bows.
notes: No shoes shown; stockings end in sheer feet. Tag says socks, but they are lace-top thigh-highs.

description_en: Navy sheer mesh lingerie set embroidered with gold stars: underwire bra with star charm, matching bikini briefs with bows and charms, star-patterned thigh-high stockings, star pendant necklace and navy satin ankle-strap stilettos.
notes: Bra and briefs are sheer; stockings have no garter visible (stay-up).

description_en: Burgundy velvet witch costume: lace-up corset mini dress with tiered lace ruffles and a high-low lace train, sheer lace puff sleeves with bows, pointed witch hat, black lace choker with ruby pendant, garter straps with lace-top bow stockings and black buckled platform boots.
notes: Halloween-style costume, season autumn is an inference.

description_en: Black and red ninja-style outfit: turtleneck long-sleeve top with chest cutout and red cord wrapping, strapped gauntlet cuffs, asymmetric wrap mini skirt with red lining, tassel sash, crossed thigh straps with a holster pouch, and black leather thigh-high stiletto boots.
notes: Boots look like leather or faux leather; not clearly latex. Bare thigh gap between skirt and boots is mannequin skin.

description_en: White satin angel costume: halter mini dress with keyhole and hip cutouts and ruched side ties, sheer long gloves, feather wings and halo, garter straps with white lace-top bow stockings and white platform ankle-strap heels.
notes: Gloves are sheer detached sleeves ending over the hand. Halloween or costume party look.

description_en: Kitsune-miko style costume: white wide-sleeve cropped kimono top with red trim and tassels, red pleated mini skirt with floral embroidery and large bow with bell, fox ear headband with bells, white thigh-high tabi-style stockings with red tassel bows, and red and black platform geta sandals.
notes: Split-toe tabi socks in thigh-high form with geta; tag lists socks. Midriff gap visible between top and skirt.
